name: cook-it
description: Cook step by step, find pantry meals, and save or export recipes. Optionally import, organize, or scale your own recipes.

interface.longDescription: Cook one step at a time, ask questions without losing your place, and find meals from ingredients you have. Save recipes to Google Docs when Drive write access is available, or export them as Markdown. You can also upload or paste your own recipe, organize it with the Cook-It template, and adjust servings.
defaultPrompt: Guide me through making tortilla de patatas for four, one step at a time.
I have eggs, potatoes and onions. What can I cook?
Organize my uploaded recipe, scale it to six servings, and export it as Markdown.
